warnings: lineage agent notes: The payment_date <= &as_of filter (line 36) controls which payments are summed. It does not drop claim rows: every claim on stg.claims appears in the output because of `if c`. first_payment_date and last_payment_date come from the first and last payment in _row_seq (keying) order, not the earliest and latest payment_date. If payments were keyed out of date order, the two can differ from MIN and MAX. For claims with no payments (not p), n_payments, n_recoveries, total_paid and recovery_flag are set to 0. indemnity_amt, expense_amt, recovery_amt and the payment dates are left missing, so gross_paid is missing too (+ on missing values gives missing). net_paid uses sum() and is also missing when all three amounts are missing. Watch for this in the PySpark port. Also, gross_paid is missing for a paid claim whose payments are all one type (for example indemnity only), because the other amount stays 0 there, not missing. In fact both amounts start at 0 for every paid claim, so gross_paid is only missing for claims with no payments. Payment types other than INDEMNITY, EXPENSE and RECOVERY count toward total_paid but toward no split column. n_recoveries and recovery_flag depend on the sign of amount, not on payment_type.
